text: Refines D-0186 for #645: a module step's deadline starts once its watchdog process is running, so the watchdog's own start, which on loaded CI runners could take most of a two-second budget, spends none of the application's time. The timeout still covers the entry, its awaitable and draining every owned thread, and stays positive, finite and at most 60 seconds. A conformance run whose runner stopped before sealing its collector stream, by a deadline or any other failure, fails as a runner that stopped before sealing its observations, not as a collector authentication failure. A stream from a runner that exited normally is authenticated exactly as before, so a forged one still fails on authentication.
